Class AnswerPersistenceAdapter

java.lang.Object
edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.adapter.out.persistence.AnswerPersistenceAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
DeleteAnswerPort, LoadAnswerPort, SaveAnswerPort
@Component class AnswerPersistenceAdapter extends Object implements SaveAnswerPort, LoadAnswerPort, DeleteAnswerPort
Persistence adapter for Answer entity. Answer has a composite primary key (answer_number, question_id) where answer_number is auto-generated (GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY), following the same pattern as ChapterPersistenceAdapter.
